note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay classifications). The Church of Sweden ceased to be the state church in 2000, so the start is pluralist secularism. Male conscription was in force; it was deactivated in 2010 and partially reactivated for men and women in 2017. The 1980 Riksdag decision to phase out nuclear power was in force (ended by the February 2009 agreement allowing reactor replacement). Immigration and healthcare classifications are gameplay judgements.
